item.title: Finding My Way Back Though Linux
item.description: I was a long-time Windows user, believing it was more practical than a Mac. However, at some point, I began to find the entire ecosystem stifling. There were too many pre-installed apps, intrusive Windows Updates, and the expectation that I would eventually have to replace my computer when support ended, even if it was still perfectly usable. Simply put, it felt outdated and overly centralized. This may have been because I had started managing my own website around the same time.
